declarations.title: Storage resource declares an enforced network perimeter association
declarations.remediation: Review the associated perimeter profile and move the supported Storage association to Enforced after validating its access rules.
declarations.scope: Native Storage association declaration only; no packet, access-rule suitability or effective-routing assertion.

declarations.title: Query-linked workspace storage declares customer-managed Table encryption
declarations.remediation: Review customer-managed encryption on the existing Query-linked storage accounts. Validate key permissions and usability separately.
declarations.scope: Existing Query-linked Storage declaration only; no requirement to enable Query links and no effective cryptography or key-usability assertion.

activation_required: Review exact proposed groups/copy and source mappings before atomic registration.
Add two ordinary metadata kinds to selected-inventory planner; no content opt-in or new auth.
Use the existing authenticated AzureTransport plus dedicated strict metadata GET and bounded reader.
Admit exact module and native fixture hashes; do not repin historical rows.
unavailable_boundaries: NSP initially supports same-subscription protected Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts only; other PaaS families/cross-subscription joins remain unresolved.
Query storage cross-subscription IDs remain unresolved; declaring a reference is not proof of selected ownership.
No live cloud calls or tenant end-to-end authentication were performed.
